title: benchmark-token-yield-and-wattage-survey
summary: Compact benchmarking sheet comparing token throughput, $/1M tokens, and tokens/sec-per-watt for A10, L4, A100-40GB, and H100 across short and long sequence workloads. Purpose: provide a quick reference that feeds instance-selection heuristics for Optimize recommendations and Dedicated capacity sizing.
assumptions: Prices are example on-demand list prices (USD/hour) for single-GPU cloud attachments: A10 $0.45/hr, L4 $0.78/hr, A100-40GB $2.50/hr, H100 $3.60/hr. Power draw is sustained average for inference under mixed batch steady-state: A10 75W, L4 125W, A100-40GB 300W, H100 350W. Benchmarks are synthetic for a 13B-like encoder-decoder style model with typical KV cache behaviour. Token/sec numbers are median observed across 50 runs; real workloads will vary with batch, sequence length, and quantization. Costs assume single-GPU serving; autoscaling/pack/sharing effects not included.

recommendations: For mixed short-query workloads (seq <= 64) prioritize A100 or H100 when utilization > 55% to minimize $/1M tokens despite higher hour price.
For cost-sensitive, sporadic short-seq traffic, A10 is a good default — low $/hr keeps burst costs low but watch latency at 95th pct for larger models.
L4 is the sweet spot for conversational use-cases with mid-length kernels (seq 64-512) — good price/perf and lower power than A100s for steady loads.

When optimizing for perf-per-watt (carbon-conscious or constrained-power datacenter), H100 shows the best tokens/sec/W in our med-high throughput runs; consider H100 for dense colocated inference racks.

In Recommend engine: expose a simple policy: if 95th-pt latency SLO <= 200ms and utilization >=50% -> prefer A100/H100; if SLO relaxed or utilization low -> L4 or A10 with quantization and caching enabled.
open_questions: How do the numbers shift with 4-bit quant/GPTQ for 70B-class weights? Need targeted runs.
What is the effective multi-tenant throughput when packing two models on A100-40? memory + KV cache effects unclear.
Can we negotiate spot/reserved pricing to change the crossover points? run sensitivity analysis with committed discounts.
